title: glsec configuration
description: The .glsec.yml configuration file of glsec, the security linter for GitLab CI/CD pipelines. https://github.com/glsec/glsec#configuration-file

rules.description: Per-rule overrides: a severity (error, warn, info) or off, as a plain value or as {severity: …}. Keys are glsec rule IDs (GL001 …) or ShellCheck codes (SC2086 …).

min-severity.description: Report only findings of this severity or higher.

gitlab-version.description: The GitLab version the pipeline runs on: a major or major.minor version such as 17.4. Rules for keywords newer than this version are skipped. Same as --gitlab-version.

trusted-hosts.description: Hostnames or CIDR ranges whose plain http:// URLs are not reported (GL016), such as an internal mirror.

allowed_registries.description: Container registries (host, or host/namespace prefix) images and services may come from. When set, GL065 reports any other registry. Empty permits any registry.

require_image_digest.description: Also report images pinned to a version tag without a sha256 digest (GL001). Off by default.

allowed_include_sources.description: Sources include:project, include:component and include:remote may use (project namespaces, component hosts or paths, remote hosts). When set, GL075 reports any other source. Empty disables the check.

shellcheck.description: ShellCheck integration: lint the shell in script:, before_script: and after_script:.

enabled.description: Run ShellCheck on every job's scripts.

path.description: The shellcheck binary. Honoured only in a file passed with --config; in a .glsec.yml glsec finds by itself it is ignored with a warning. Use --shellcheck-path instead.

require_ignore_reason.description: Make an inline # glsec:ignore without a -- reason a policy violation (exit 2). The .glsec-ignore baseline is not affected.

strict.description: Warn findings also exit 1. Same as --strict.

no-exit-codes.description: Always exit 0 when the scan succeeds, whatever it finds (advisory runs). Overrides strict. Same as --no-exit-codes.

exclude_paths.description: Files not to scan: glob patterns, and directories ending in / or /**.

recursive_patterns.description: More file names or paths that --recursive scans besides .gitlab-ci.yml. A pattern without / matches the file name, one with / the path relative to the scanned directory.

owasp.description: Run only the rules in these OWASP Top 10 CI/CD Security Risks categories.

owasp_exclude.description: Skip the rules in these OWASP Top 10 CI/CD Security Risks categories.

ruleSeverity.description: error, warn or info sets the rule's severity; off turns the rule off.

ruleId.description: A glsec rule ID. Generated from the rule registry: go test ./cmd/glsec -run TestConfigSchema -update
